facts.fact: Article 53 of Loi n° 008/AN/SENAT/2025 (finance law 2026) makes electronic signature compulsory for administrative correspondence in the finance ministry from 1 January 2026 and states it has the same legal value as a handwritten signature.
facts.system: Loi n° 008/AN/SENAT/2025 portant loi de finances pour l'exercice 2026, article 53
